title: Intellia Therapeutics to Present at Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Intellia Therapeutics's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
CAMBRIDGE, Mass., Sept. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Intellia Therapeutics, Inc.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=NKQhjZ1oeqEaZyeK8fJ1H6rlR51ChlBbLsGGqgI13Dm-r4gCVBOmd_TZ9Kf-6Mt6qgOzik9lB5C-dO-dXMwLVsQkqTF2qmyz8xK6j8Gx7BQ=) (Nasdaq: NTLA), a leading biopharmaceutical company focused on revolutionizing medicine leveraging CRISPR gene editing and other core technologies, today announced that the company will present at the Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference on Monday, September 14, 2026 at 4:05 p.m. ET.


A live webcast will be available on the Events and Presentations page in the Investors & Media section of Intellia’s website,[www.intelliatx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=z4XciRwxZhTRPE1lcwvSSLtGwbWiHRn0L2UQaMT1RoLUK-wDImsYbYjI7svmzRvN-d2uB_O6zTOLPpmPaQfV9zDAAkPxo7T5qPqbeLOOBBRVh0jbEE6-_NT2nbcB11Raml1IPS2qD03RRaQ4rf7hDHWUTexVR2ovoqdDxG9OfpJVLohiKqet0091J9mbazj8ogVF-ogqsKprkhFBuiOq6tx8ueLrxBHRgzTJJmsgp_xMGG9VzskqrEqbGqOAobhspC2MM8qAFyQBP1c5KVrKR8d8dg1XXnwxynt5A86GhZfIfyqWEpjt6LqmNBy7DxNVgGsVfkfW-wwNnsjZpFqbT6Ztb99XyGJ8hyYKl-mfDAT9EabNIb4O1FOljcY0zEg9Lwdz2jbiPhBGq00af22W7n77ExDdoyCH3LygCYpSM_XxNnyftxqnDKMWka0tOT06EctFgZcwzJr47PCa4mZumss-CWVUdXF78fU46Wgcumw=) . A replay of the webcast will be available on Intellia’s website for approximately 90 days.


**About Intellia Therapeutics**
Intellia Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: NTLA) is a leading clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on revolutionizing medicine leveraging CRISPR gene editing and other core technologies. The company’s mission is to transform the lives of people with severe diseases by developing and commercializing potentially curative treatments. With deep scientific, technical and clinical development experience, Intellia aims to reset the standard for medicine by durably treating the root causes of disease. Learn more at[intelliatx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=h_B3sIt8khO6BCwY2xPM9chMPt7IOPuwfcGg8_-q3NLgDFIKzomA4hxOIEOZaiFeVjuZ-sdtKXlFPnvI27fSZkSGXaqNWy_h9go9uDh0Z3A=) and follow us[@intelliatx](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=e-rOCErn36DQu42x1Yc911fupa-C2GzpZTm-qkqPW8Sx6Gx4NxTbIfNppwv3VykPeUuxEkRujhbGBgouu5P0Uw==) .
